name: Pipeliners - City FAQ Drafts 7 Pages 2026-08-26
body:
> Plan · Pipeliners · 2026-08-26

# Summary
Localized FAQ drafts (v2, simplified) for the 7 city pages that had no FAQ: Surprise, Sun City West, Tolleson, Laveen, Sun Lakes, Rio Verde and Cave Creek. 8 questions per page, 30-45 word answers, first person as Pipeliners, matching the approved Gilbert/Scottsdale style. v1 read like a civics lesson and was cut down.

# Claims used (from the site at the time)
50+ year liners, 20-year drain warranty, 10-year ePIPE warranty, NSF/ANSI 61 coating, licensed ePIPE partners, same-day water in many cases, camera first, permits pulled. Not claimed: prices, savings percentages, stats, reviews, ZIP lists, permit fees, septic vs sewer.

# Status
Six were deployed on Aug 26 (Cave Creek had been done by hand); see [Pipeliners - Design Audit Local Pages 2026-08-26](lib:brain-pipeliners-design-audit-local-pages-2026-08-26). Two claims in these answers are now banned or unverified (Oct 1): "same day" water and "licensed ePIPE partners". Check live FAQs before reuse.
